title: NASA-UAP-D031, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 2, 1996
doc_notes: This document is a NASA record describing a photograph of an unidentified object captured during the STS-80 space shuttle mission in 1996.

incidents.summary: Astronauts aboard Space Shuttle Columbia captured an image of a small, bright, triangular unidentified object in low-Earth orbit during the STS-80 mission.
